title: The Polar Express
edition: Warner Home Video DVD with menus (c) 2005, as shown by the supplied walkthrough: the Credits page reads "Photography (c) 2004, Menu Design & Supplementary Material (c) 2005 Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc." and the Languages page lists English 5.1, Espanol 5.1, Francais 5.1 (double au Quebec), i.e. a North American release. The exact disc edition is not independently verified.

provenance.source: The Polar Express - menu walkthrough recording supplied by the pack author (videoplayback.mp4: 640x360, 25 fps, 124.09 s, AAC audio)
provenance.measured: recording frames 0..909 (t = 0..36.40 s); the main-menu loop starts at frame 910 (36.40 s) and the clip hands over to it with no crossfade

provenance.source: The Polar Express - menu walkthrough recording supplied by the pack author (videoplayback.mp4: 640x360, 25 fps, 124.09 s, AAC audio)
provenance.measured: Play Movie clip = recording frames 2946..3075 (117.84..123.00 s); it ends on a flat dark grey that the recording holds for at least 1.24 s more

provenance.source: The Polar Express - menu walkthrough recording supplied by the pack author (videoplayback.mp4: 640x360, 25 fps, 124.09 s, AAC audio)
provenance.measured: music onset 0.39 s (frame 2173 -> 87.31 s) and 0.41 s (frame 2800 -> 112.41 s) after the loop re-entry; the three onsets (63.775, 87.31, 112.41 s) align to 0.7 ms. One full cycle is 31.914 s (onset to onset), ending in about 0.77 s of silence before the music restarts. The file is that cycle: its first 4.54 s are taken from a clean return-to-menu pass (the first pass has the intro mixed in), the rest from the first menu pass, spliced with a 90 ms crossfade where the two correlate at 0.98.
provenance.status: measured; the loop point and the splice have not been listened to on a device
provenance.formatNote: Opus 64 kbps stereo from the recording's AAC audio; gapless looping via the two-item repeat not yet verified on a device

playMovie.letterHoldStatus: UNKNOWN: the recording ends 1.24 s into the held dark frame; how long the disc waits before the film is not shown. The engine starts the film when the clip ends.

measured.source: The Polar Express - menu walkthrough recording supplied by the pack author (videoplayback.mp4: 640x360, 25 fps, 124.09 s, AAC audio)
measured.activation: the underline turns pale at 65.88 s (scenes), 90.68 s (languages), 114.84 s (play); the clip starts at 68.28 / 92.80 / 117.84 s: 2400 / 2120 / 3000 ms. The pale underline stays 1400 / 1040 / 2000 ms and then goes out (frames 1682, 2293, 2921); a dark swirl then plays over the menu, which is NOT reproduced.
measured.music: cut 0.69, 0.69 and 0.70 s before the clip starts (67.62, 92.11, 117.14 s); the transition sound starts 0.82, 0.80 and 0.85 s after the clip starts.
measured.pages: on every page the highlighted underline goes out at the press, and the page changes 560 ms later (14 frames) for the tabs and Next, 1120 ms later (28 frames) for Main Menu
measured.returnToMain: cuts back to the loop start (entry phase 0 +- 3 frames); the music restarts 0.4 s later

provenanceNotes.coordinateSystem: 640x360 pixels, top-left origin, the recording's own frame; every picture and video is stored at that size and scaled by the engine
provenanceNotes.observedMainLabels: x 133-197 Play Movie, 213-313 Scene Selections, 331-429 Theatrical Trailer, 447-507 Languages; text rows 303-320 (measured on the cleaned loop)
provenanceNotes.cleanedLoop: the gold underline that the recording shows on the selected button is removed from the loop (inpainted); the engine draws it back as a sprite. A faint smudge can remain where the underline crossed the text.
provenanceNotes.pagePlates: median of the recording frames in which the page is static
notReproduced: the dark swirl that plays over the menu after a main-menu button is pressed

provenanceNotes.chapterMapping: the 24 scene thumbnails use chapter:1 .. chapter:24 = the 1st .. 24th chapter the server lists for the film; the disc shows 24 scenes, so a copy with a different chapter count shows a notice
provenanceNotes.languages: audio:en / es / fr and subtitle:en / es / fr / off pick the film's own tracks by language tag on the server; nothing is bundled
